readout_other: 13-channel cortical EEG with phase transfer entropy network analysis; Y-maze spontaneous alternation and distance
direction_notes: In SHR (ADHD model) rats, 7 days of prefrontal TUS increased Y-maze spontaneous alternation and reduced hyperactivity versus SHR and SHR-SHAM, and shifted theta- and beta-band cortical network measures; no net excitation or inhibition was defined.

exposures.label: TUS to right prefrontal cortex for 7 days

timing.protocol_description: FF 500 kHz, PRF 1 Hz, DC 5% and stimulation duration (SD) 50 ms; total duration of each stimulation 15 min, once daily for 7 days.

flags.reason: 16 SD, 16 SHR and 16 WKY rats were used, split into control and TUS groups of 8; plus an SHR-SHAM group of N = 8 whose origin is not explained. Group sizes of the three TUS groups given; total exposed not stated.
Paper states stimulation duration 50 ms with PRF 1 Hz and DC 5%; 50 ms is taken as the pulse length by the burst rule (DC/PRF = 50 ms).
15 min is the total duration of each stimulation session of 1 Hz pulses; it is not one uninterrupted train.
Intensity unit printed as 'w/cm-2' (garbled); Ispta stated as 215.8 mW/cm-2 and converted to 0.2158 W/cm2; domain not stated.
Anaesthesia state during TUS not stated; isoflurane used for surgery only; behaviour in freely moving rats.
